name: Marou Vietnamese chocolate
about: Marou is a Ho Chi Minh City chocolate brand that makes bars from single-origin Vietnamese cacao. It is a local favorite for gifts.
tip: Ask for packaging that keeps the chocolate from melting on the trip home.

name: Vietnamese robusta coffee and phin filter
about: Vietnamese coffee is strong and often served with condensed milk. The phin is the small metal drip filter used to brew it at home.
tip: Check the coffee label to see whether flavorings have been added.
